description.value:
Does your child want to be a soldier of the future? Do they want to protect your home from those nasty free state leeches? Get them a Hangman, and they’ll live out their dreams with an easy to use, high capacity, low caliber automatic. Plus, it’s quiet, meaning the kids can play inside without disturbing their parents’ BD trip!

Cost: 25eb (Everyday)

Class: Poor Quality SMG • Skill: Handgun • Range: SMG

Damage: 2d6 • Capacity: 50 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (SMG 3), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Silencer (Non-Removable) • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load modified Small Game Ammunition (50eb (Costly) per 100) which also functions as Tracer Ammunition.

Range: SMG
Pre-installed: Silencer (Non-Removable) (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (SMG 3), Suppressive Fire

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
